page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara.ch) with logo, title block and licence notes. No printed text of the book.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the printed book, so not transcribed. Its title block gives: Fr. Junii Biturigis Animadversiones ad tres libros de translatione imperii romani a Graecis ad Francos, quos Robertus Bellarminus Politianus societatis Jesu (ut vocant) disputationum suarum libris ... ; Du Jon, François; [Genève ou Heidelberg], 1603; Bibliothèque de Genève, shelf mark To 2170.
